name: gr_set_union_ne_univ_card_le
statement: (n : ℕ) (𝒜 : Finset (Finset (Fin n))) (h : ∀ A ∈ 𝒜, ∀ B ∈ 𝒜, A ∪ B ≠ Finset.univ) : 2 * 𝒜.card ≤ 2 ^ n
closed: ∀ (n : ℕ) (𝒜 : Finset (Finset (Fin n))) (h : ∀ A ∈ 𝒜, ∀ B ∈ 𝒜, A ∪ B ≠ Finset.univ), 2 * 𝒜.card ≤ 2 ^ n
informal: A family of subsets of [n] in which no two members (possibly equal) cover [n] has at most 2^(n−1) members — the family of complements is intersecting (Aᶜ ∩ Bᶜ = (A ∪ B)ᶜ ≠ ∅), has the same cardinality, and Set.Intersecting.card_le applies; alternatively 𝒜 contains at most one of each complementary pair.
type: ∀ (n : ℕ) (𝒜 : Finset (Finset (Fin n))), (∀ A ∈ 𝒜, ∀ B ∈ 𝒜, A ∪ B ≠ Finset.univ) → 2 * 𝒜.card ≤ 2 ^ n
